The '''Oluna Biqua Elite Guard''' was a security force that was based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oluna Biqua]], on [[Genarius]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
When the population of [[Oluna Biqua]] was infected with the gas [[Trinex-M]], some members of the guard managed to avoid contact with it by wearing [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]]. Twelve of them accompanied the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Ti-Ori Tamun]], the city's second-in-command, when he traveled to [[Port Epsilon]], the city's emergency port, to meet with the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who arrived aboard the [[YT-1220]] ''[[Headliner]]''. The Guard escorted them to an office, where the city's [[Comptroller]], [[Nestin Thokor]], was waiting for them.

==Equipment==
The Guard wore battle [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. They also carried multichannel [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]].
